segments.text:
27 Daniel anſwered in the preſence of the king,
and ſayd: the ſecret which the king hath demaunded, can neither the wiſe, the aſtrologians, the inchanters, nor the ſoutheſayers declare vnto the king.

28 But there is a God in heauen that reueileth ſecretes, and ſheweth the king Nebuchadnezer what ſhalbe in the latter dayes. Thy dreame and the thinges which thou haſt ſene in thine head vpon thy bed, is this.
29 O king, whē thou waſt in thy bed, thoughts came into thy minde what ſhould come to paſſe hereafter, and he that reueileth ſecretes, telleth thee what ſhall come.
